codeReview.summary: VAL-SKEL-016 is correctly implemented. The feature adds AgentAskUpdateMalformed, modifies SSE parsing to emit malformed events instead of silently dropping unknown/invalid frames, and renders a visible indicator in the CockpitScreen detail lane. All 7 new tests pass under -race.

issues.description: TestAgentAskStreamRuntime_MalformedViaFakeSSEServer does not verify that Submit returns an error when the fake SSE server sends malformed JSON. The test passes by virtue of channel closure (2s timeout guard in collectAgentAskUpdates), but the error from Submit is silently ignored. The behavior being tested (malformed detection + recovery) works correctly — well-formed tokens do arrive and malformed updates are emitted — so VAL-SKEL-016 (i) and (iv) are satisfied. However, the test would not catch a future regression where Submit returned an error AND no updates were emitted. Consider adding: if err := rt.Submit(...); err != nil { /* error is expected */ } after the malformed frame.

TestAgentAskStreamRuntime_MalformedInvalidJSONPayload sets ContentDelta: "{not json"} but mapEventToUpdate uses event.Content (not ContentDelta) for the Malformed.RawData field. The test still passes and correctly verifies malformed detection via an empty-phase event, but the ContentDelta field is dead code in this test path. Either use Content instead of ContentDelta, or add a separate test case that exercises ContentDelta specifically through the fake SSE server path (where JSON parsing populates ContentDelta from the parsed struct).

summary: VAL-SKEL-016 implementation is sound. The feature adds AgentAskUpdateMalformed type, modifies SSE parsing to emit malformed events for unknown types and invalid JSON instead of silently dropping frames, and renders a visible 💔 malformed event indicator in the CockpitScreen detail lane and evidence drawer. 7 new tests cover runtime-level malformed handling (4 tests) and cockpit-level rendering/interaction (3 tests). All tests pass under -race. Two non-blocking test quality notes: (1) the fake SSE server test doesn't verify that Submit returns an error on malformed JSON, though the actual behavior being tested works correctly; (2) one test uses ContentDelta where Content would be more precise. go-tui v0.11.0 pinned correctly; no off-limits paths modified.
